episodes.synopsis: Red and Yellow are lost in a mysterious maze, where they're chased by a unicycle-riding monkey toy and a hungry fish.
episodes.title: Maze

episodes.synopsis: Chuck tries to cook some delicious seafood, but Yellow keeps interfering because Red is trapped inside Chuck's fish!
episodes.title: Fire

episodes.synopsis: After losing a game of beach volleyball to the mudskippers, Red, Yellow and friends recruit a mentor to train them.
episodes.title: Beach Volleyball

episodes.synopsis: A city rat and his cronies -- including a hungry frog -- invade the island, forcing Red and Yellow to defend their home.
episodes.title: Larva Rangers 1

episodes.synopsis: A battle royale rages with the big-city invaders on one side and Red, Yellow and their island allies on the other.
episodes.title: Larva Rangers 2

episodes.synopsis: Fed up with Red and Yellow's antics, Chuck tries to set a trap and get rid of them forever.
episodes.title: A Lucky Day

episodes.synopsis: Crabsformer falls in love with a lady crab, but she and the island's other crabs are frightened by his powers.
episodes.title: Crabsformer 2

episodes.synopsis: Booby is lovestruck over an inflatable, rubber ducky-shaped inner tube, then mistakenly thinks it's laid an egg.
episodes.title: Booby’s Love

episodes.synopsis: When the island's volcano starts to erupt, Mango tries to remember the magical drum spell that her parents once used to stop it.
episodes.title: Mango’s Parents

episodes.synopsis: Just as the islanders are suffering from extreme summer heat, a rogue iceberg arrives to cool things off.
episodes.title: Iceberg

episodes.synopsis: When a typhoon hits the island, Chuck and the other islanders get sucked up inside of it and must poke its "eye" to stop it.
episodes.title: Storm

episodes.synopsis: The volcano erupts again, and a heroic Chuck springs into action. Can he get the islanders to safety?
episodes.title: Escape

episodes.synopsis: Adrift on a raft, Chuck, Red, Yellow, Clara and Crabsformer pull together as a team -- until their raft breaks up.
episodes.title: Drift
